reasoning: The brief asks only for a visual mood piece: rain streaking a bus window at night with the city sliding past outside. No spoken words, no visible lettering, and the silent flag forbids non-diegetic score, so requested speech/music/onscreen_text all stay false and music is forbidden. No reference media is supplied, so the request alone governs medium, palette, lighting and framing; no replacements are implied. Balanced creativity permits additions, but every addition category is either unrequested or forbidden here, so the scene stays a pure two-shot observation of water on glass and passing lights within the 5167 ms target: a close static hold on the beads gathering and running, then a slight pull that reveals the interior reflection while the outside city smears into moving streaks. Diegetic rain and a low engine hum are the only sound, attached as sync sound rather than score.

shots.action: Raindrops bead and tremble on the outer surface of a bus window, then one heavy drop breaks loose and drags a wavering trail down the glass, splitting the blurred neon and sodium lights of the night city into long wet streaks behind it.
subjects: night city lights beyond the glass
shots.what_changes: A single drop gathers, releases and carves a clear path through the condensation, revealing sharper streetlight streaks in its wake.

shots.action: The view eases back from the glass so the shadowed interior of the bus and a faint reflection of the aisle appear across the pane, while outside the streetlights and lit shopfronts slide steadily sideways and are stretched into horizontal glowing smears by the motion and the water.
shots.what_changes: Framing widens to include the dim interior reflection, and the outside lights shift from vertical streak trails to horizontal motion smears as the bus travels.

style: Cinematic live-action night photography, vertical 9:16 framing, shallow depth of field with the raindrops tack-sharp and the city dissolved into soft neon bokeh, deep blue-black shadows against warm amber and magenta highlights, wet glass reflections, fine 35mm grain, natural handheld-free steadiness, muted contrast with glowing specular highlights on each droplet.
